kv18.6:2.3: yā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sā’va dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv18.6:3.1: paṭhamā jhānā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ saṅkamati, na vattabbaṃ
kv18.6:3.2: “yā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sā’va dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv18.6:3.4: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ anāvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… appaṇidahantassa uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:3.6: nanu dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:3.8: hañci dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati. no ca vata re vattabbe
kv18.6:4.3: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kāme ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:4.5: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ kāme ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:5.1: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ savitakkaṃ savicāranti. pa. paṭiññā
kv18.6:5.7: taññeva paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ taṃ dutiyaṃ jhānanti.
kv18.6:6.3: yā dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sā’va tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv18.6:7.1: dutiyā jhānā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ saṅkamati, na vattabbaṃ
kv18.6:7.2: “yā dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sā’va tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv18.6:7.4: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ anāvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… appaṇidahantassa uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:7.6: nanu tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:7.8: hañci tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati. no ca vata re vattabbe
kv18.6:8.3: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ vitakkavicāre ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:8.5: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ vitakkavicāre ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:9.7: taññeva dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānanti
kv18.6:10.3: yā tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sā’va catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti.
kv18.6:11.1: tatiyā jhānā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ saṅkamati, na vattabbaṃ
kv18.6:11.2: “yā tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sā’va catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī’ti.
kv18.6:11.4: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ anāvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… appaṇidahantassa uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:11.6: nanu catutthaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:11.8: hañci catutthaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati. no ca vata re vattabbe
kv18.6:12.3: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ pītiṃ ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:12.5: catuttha jhānaṃ pītiṃ ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatī’ti.
kv18.6:13.7: taññeva tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ taṃ catutthaṃ jhānanti.
